issue: Base FENCE instructions with nonzero rd/rs1 or nonzero fm/pred/succ fields were incorrectly trapped.
normative_basis: RISC-V Unprivileged ISA v20260120, section 1.1.7: FENCE rs1 and rd are ignored, and reserved fm/predecessor/successor configurations are treated as normal FENCE instructions. https://docs.riscv.org/reference/isa/v20260120/unpriv/rv32.html
repair: For opcode 0001111, accept funct3=000 as a FENCE no-op without validating rd, rs1, or the remaining instruction fields. Continue to trap unsupported funct3 values.

verification.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; from fpga_agent.cpu_bench import run_benchmark; r=run_benchmark(Path('benchmarks/rv32_multi'), seeds=0); print('status=',r['status'],'cases=',r['case_count'],'board_soc=',r['board_soc'])"
